text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon and I are heading back
to the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm going to make a stop by the
laboratory. I
want to see how my new
concoction is coming
along.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It should be ready tomorrow, so we can
move on
to the experiment in the
morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, like any other day, Agnes
Tachyon is
continuing her research and
experimentation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What kind of question is that?! My work
is
changing every day, you know!
choice_data_list: 研究に飽きたことはあるか？
研究に飽きたことはある？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for my research. My
understanding
of muscles, the organs,
bone structure, and the
like...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What is considered conventional
knowledge
today might be disproved
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why the path to body

modification is so involved and
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's right. So, now that you get it, I
will see you
tomorrow. Good night,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: 飽きる暇もないんだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nice morning, isn't it? Here, take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately after greeting me, she
hands me a
pill which smells
indescribably horrendous. I'm
forced to
swallow it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It makes you want to vomit,
doesn't it? But
worry not, your suffering
will turn out to be worth
it in the end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll see what I'm talking about once it
starts
taking effect! Now come on! Run
around the track
with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I run for an hour or so, but the effects
Agnes
Tachyon mentioned don't seem to
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More than anything, the stench of the
pill still
lingers in my mouth, making the
whole experience
rather... torturous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Your pulse when running is no
different
than normal. No change in the
color of your
muscles either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You do seem a bit pale in the face... but,
I'll
assume that's for another reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've got it, Trainer! In short, this
experiment...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Is a failure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, your time for the last 200 meters
was a bit
faster than usual.
choice_data_list: 苦しい思いをしただけ！？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The difference is almost insignificant,
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As you were supposed to feel light as a
feather,
this slight improvement might
not be so—

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were doing dangerous
experiments
like creating drugs to make
you run faster, but...
I'm surprised the
rumors are true.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You must also be a student at
Tracen
Academy. Does this mean you're
interested?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But first, allow me to correct one thing.
The
concoctions I put together are—

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please! Can I have some?! I... want to
become
faster!

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm always losing... so I don't care if I
cheat
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on a second. What I do here
isn't
cheating...

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm begging you! I'll be waiting, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having said what she came to say, the

curly-haired Umamusume runs off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, if she really wants my

concoction, shouldn't she be helping me
in
return?
choice_data_list: 考え直すように言おう

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She just wants to take the fruits of my
hard work.
I'm not impressed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, next time I see her, I'm going
to make
sure she joins the experiment
properly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I'm looking forward to this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon laughs merrily as she
watches the
departing Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She'll see. There's no such thing as
cheating when
it comes to my
experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm intrigued. Her eyes were
burning with
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet, she seems so eager to utilize
artificial
enhancements. I should look
into this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon chuckles to herself as
she watches
the departing
Umamusume...
